newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti MD pleased inquiry is closed.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti MD pleased inquiry is closed.

text.p: The managing director of Italy's Olivetti information technology group said he was pleased with the outcome of a preliminary parliamentary enquiry into the company's affairs.

A lower house parliamentary commission which has held a series of hearings into the troubled company earlier on Wednesday decided to conclude its study without making a decision to open a formal inquiry.
Roberto Colaninno told reporters, "This is an act of faith by parliament and reinforces our commitment to relaunch Olivetti which is a national asset."
He made his remarks as he left an executive meeting of the Italian employers' federation Confindustria.
Asked by a reporter if Olivetti had yet found a buyer for its personal computer business, Colaninno said, "not yet."
Olivetti had planned to sell its loss-making PC business by the end of this year but Colaninno said last month that there might be a delay in the sell-off.
An Olivetti spokesman said the group's policy was not to comment on ongoing negotiations. "When the sale is completed we will say so," he added.
